name: Meyer Lemon
siboNotes: Low FODMAP citrus fruits like Meyer lemons are generally well-tolerated and provide natural digestive support through citric acid.
preparationTips: Use both zest and juice for maximum flavor without FODMAP concerns
Meyer lemon juice makes an excellent low-FODMAP salad dressing base
Store at room temperature for up to 1 week or refrigerate for 3-4 weeks
Choose fruits that feel heavy for their size and have smooth, thin skin
